patthana23.30:1.1: na mahaggataṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā mahaggato kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā nava.
patthana23.30:2.1: na mahaggataṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā paritto akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.30:3.1: na parittaṃ na abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca paritto abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha. naparittārammaṇattika nakusalattike parittārammaṇattika kusalattikaṃ
